# Smithsonian Magazine

> Smithsonian Magazine publishes in-depth journalism and daily stories on history, science, arts, culture, travel and the Smithsonian Institution.

The site combines magazine features, breaking news, category archives, multimedia, newsletters and special projects from Smithsonian Magazine, with additional access to subscriptions, the annual photo contest, videos, podcasts and Smithsonian-affiliated commerce and travel offerings.

## Main Editorial Sections

- [Smart News](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/smart-news/): Daily news coverage on discoveries, research, culture and current events.
- [History](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/history/): Reporting and features on world history, American history and historical interpretation.
- [Science](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/science-nature/): Articles on nature, archaeology, space, animals, climate and scientific research.
- [Innovation](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/innovation/): Coverage of technology, invention, engineering and future-focused ideas.
- [Arts & Culture](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/arts-culture/): Stories on film, books, art, music, design and cultural history.
- [Travel](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/travel/): Destination features, cultural travel reporting and place-based storytelling.
- [At the Smithsonian](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/smithsonian-institution/): News and features about museums, collections, exhibitions and Smithsonian work.

## Magazine Front Door

- [Homepage](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/): Main entry point for latest features, Smart News and editorial highlights.
- [Latest Features](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/): Homepage section surfacing longform stories and current magazine features.
- [Uncover Past Secrets](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/): Homepage editorial package highlighting history and archaeology storytelling.
- [Current Issue Subscription Offer](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com/?idx=1913&inetz=side_menu&promo_name=current-issue&promo_position=left_nav&promo_creative=button&promo_id=subscribe): Subscription landing page tied to the current magazine issue.
- [Email Newsletters](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/email/): Newsletter signup hub for Smithsonian Magazine editorial updates.

## History Coverage

- [History](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/history/): Central archive for historical reporting, essays and feature stories.
- [Archaeology](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/history/): History section regularly featuring archaeology discoveries and ancient worlds coverage.
- [American History](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/history/): Historical stories on U.S. politics, society, conflict and public memory.
- [World History](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/history/): Reporting on global civilizations, empires, archives and historical figures.

## Science & Nature Coverage

- [Science](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/science-nature/): Main archive for science, nature and environment reporting.
- [Archaeology News](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/science-nature/): Scientific and archaeological discoveries covered within the science archive.
- [Space](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/science-nature/): Stories on astronomy, spaceflight, planets and celestial events.
- [Animals](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/science-nature/): Reporting on wildlife, conservation, evolution and animal behavior.
- [Environment](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/science-nature/): Coverage of climate, ecosystems and environmental change.

## Culture, Media & Arts

- [Arts & Culture](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/arts-culture/): Main archive for arts, entertainment and cultural analysis.
- [Film & Television](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/arts-culture/): Features on movies, television history and screen culture.
- [Books](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/arts-culture/): Literary coverage, author features and book-related cultural reporting.
- [Art & Design](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/arts-culture/): Stories on visual art, museums, architecture and design history.
- [Music & Performance](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/arts-culture/): Coverage of musicians, performance traditions and cultural expression.

## Innovation & Ideas

- [Innovation](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/innovation/): Archive for technology, invention and innovation journalism.
- [Technology](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/innovation/): Reporting on digital tools, engineering and scientific applications.
- [Invention](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/innovation/): Stories about inventors, breakthroughs and transformative ideas.
- [Future of Work and Society](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/innovation/): Innovation coverage connecting technology with social change.

## Travel & Place

- [Travel](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/travel/): Destination reporting and essays rooted in culture, history and geography.
- [Cultural Travel](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/travel/): Travel stories emphasizing heritage, museums, food and local traditions.
- [Historic Destinations](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/travel/): Place-based features focused on historically significant sites.
- [Nature Travel](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/travel/): Reporting on landscapes, wildlife destinations and outdoor exploration.

## Smithsonian Institution Coverage

- [At the Smithsonian](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/smithsonian-institution/): Coverage of Smithsonian museums, research and institutional initiatives.
- [Museum News](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/smithsonian-institution/): Articles on exhibitions, collections and museum programming.
- [Collections & Research](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/smithsonian-institution/): Stories about artifacts, archives, specimens and scholarship.
- [Smithsonian People & Projects](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/category/smithsonian-institution/): Features on curators, scientists and institutional work.

## Multimedia

- [Podcast](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/podcast/): Podcast hub for Smithsonian Magazine audio storytelling and interviews.
- [Videos](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/video/): Video library featuring reported segments and visual storytelling.
- [Photo Contest](https://photocontest.smithsonianmag.com/photocontest/): Annual photography contest with entries, finalists and reader participation.
- [Newsletters](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/email/): Email products for recurring editorial and topical updates.

## Reader Services

- [Subscribe](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com/?idx=1913&inetz=side_menu&promo_name=current-issue&promo_position=left_nav&promo_creative=button&promo_id=subscribe): Start a print magazine subscription through Smithsonian Magazine offers.
- [Give a Gift](https://subscribe.smithsonianmag.com/gift?idx=579&inetz=side_menu&promo_name=current-issue&promo_position=left_nav&promo_creative=button&promo_id=gift): Purchase a gift subscription for another reader.
- [Renew](https://ssl.drgnetwork.com/flex/SMT/SMRENEWAL/): Renewal portal for existing Smithsonian Magazine subscribers.
- [Smithsonian Store](https://www.smithsonianstore.com): Official retail site for Smithsonian-themed books, gifts and merchandise.
- [Smithsonian Journeys](https://www.smithsonianjourneys.org): Smithsonian-affiliated travel program offering educational tours and trips.
